bio.short: TWON is a San Francisco DJ who lives in the crossover. House, tech house, and afro house drive his sets, and he flips between them and hip hop and R&B so smoothly the floor never feels the switch. Vibes curator, festival lover, and the guy who can take a room from a West Coast throwback to a four on the floor peak in one blend.
long: TWON is a San Francisco DJ built for the crossover. His sets run on house, tech house, and afro house, and he moves between those and hip hop and R&B without ever dropping the groove.

That range is the point. He can open with rolling afro house, build to a tech house peak, then flip a hip hop classic into a house edit and keep the whole room with him. A festival lover at heart, TWON reads the floor first and plays for the vibe, not the playlist.

His own edits, like House Every Weekend (TWON x BRWDY Edit), live right on that line between scenes, and his DEEP CUTZ series digs into the catalogs that shaped them, starting with YG. TODO: add where you play, residencies, or what's next.
